Archive PDF

Prepare a clean, long-lived copy — honestly.

Flatten form values, remove scripts and open actions, normalise dates and write descriptive metadata. Everything an archival workflow needs, with a clear statement of what only a validator can certify.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Archive PDF works

  1. Add the PDF and review its metadata.
  2. Choose flattening, action stripping and dates.
  3. Prepare and download an unencrypted archival copy.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools
